theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ℓ : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclid P)), 0 < ℓ → MeasurableSet A → Bornology.IsBounded A → μH[ℓ] {x | x ∈ A ∧ ¬ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < δ ∧ ∀ C : ℕ → Set (Euclid P), A ∩ ball x ρ ⊆ ⋃ j, C j → ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ ℓ ≤ 2 * ∑' j, Metric.ediam (C j) ^ ℓ} = 0
